consent.aiBody: Kassa's assistant is an AI. It sees your chat with names and account numbers replaced by placeholders, and it can only draft payments.
consent.piplBody: You are in region CN and Kassa's AI runs outside mainland China. Under China's PIPL (Art. 38–39) this cross-border transfer needs your separate consent. You can withdraw it at any time.
consent.failed: Kassa could not save your consent. Try again.

emptyBody: Ask for a payment, a budget check or a log. Kassa drafts it, and you approve it with your passkey.
